command: set -euo pipefail; echo BOUNDARY=REAL_LOCAL_HOST_AI_CORE_NODE_NOT_SANDBOXED; echo USER=$(id -un); echo HOST=$(hostname); echo '=== candidate repos ==='; for d in $HOME/frankenstein-repo $HOME/frankenstein-2.0 $HOME/frankenstein $HOME/entityos-repo $HOME/.local/lib/frankenstein-voice-final; do if [ -e "$d" ]; then echo PATH=$d; if git -C "$d" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo REPO=$(git -C "$d" remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null || true); echo BRANCH=$(git -C "$d" branch --show-current); echo HEAD=$(git -C "$d" rev-parse HEAD); echo STATUS=$(git -C "$d" status --porcelain=v1 | wc -l); fi; fi; done; echo '=== matching dirs ==='; find $HOME -maxdepth 2 -type d \( -iname '*frankenstein*' -o -iname '*omega*' \) -print 2>/dev/null | sort | head -80; echo '=== systemd user services ==='; systemctl --user list-unit-files --type=service --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'frankenstein|omega|entity|voice|gespraech' || true; echo '=== active processes ==='; ps -eo pid,ppid,args --sort=pid | grep -Ei 'frankenstein|omega|voice_final|voice_full|realtime_gespraech|gespraechsmodus|stern.py' | grep -v grep || true; echo '=== FRED/crush harness ==='; for f in $HOME/frankenstein-repo/FRED.md $HOME/frankenstein-repo/CRUSH.md $HOME/.claude/star/harness_fred.py $HOME/.claude/star/harness_fred.sh $HOME/.claude/star/harness_crush.py $HOME/.claude/star/harness_crush_knopf.py $HOME/.config/crush/FRED.md; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then echo FILE=$f SHA=$(sha256sum "$f" | awk '{print $1}'); fi; done; echo '=== voice final ==='; if [ -d $HOME/.local/lib/frankenstein-voice-final/scripts ]; then ls -1 $HOME/.local/lib/frankenstein-voice-final/scripts | grep -E 'omega|voice|stern|grid10' | head -80; fi; echo INVENTORY_PASS
